note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super and one key-word line, so 3 graphics and the end card.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: A thank you to our top lenders

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1, top: “A thank you to our top lenders”
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third. Nothing else on screen with it.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:05–00:08, small, lower left above the captions: “Vishal Ghotge” / CEO at Kiva
mg.use: Put it on at 00:05 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line <CEO at Kiva> under it.

mg.title: Key words

text.main: your contributions are making a big difference

mg.cue: Key words, top third, as he says them: “your contributions are making a big difference”
mg.use: Put it on as he says these words and hold about 3 s, in the top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card on dark forest green #223829: Kiva logo, then “Give a little. Change a lot.” and kiva.org.
